chapterInfo.content:
8
Akyɛdeɛ a ɛfiri Makedonia
1 # Rom 15.26 Nanso, anuanom, yɛrema moahunu Nyankopɔn adom a wɔde adom Makedonia asafo no, 2ɛfiri sɛ, wɔn ahohiahia sɔhwɛ kɛseɛ mu no, wɔn anigyeɛ buu so maa wɔn wɔ wɔn hia bebrebe mu mpo, wɔyii ayamyɛ kɛseɛ kyerɛe; 3na medi wɔn ho adanseɛ sɛ, wɔde wɔn ara wɔn pɛ maa sɛdeɛ wɔbɛtumi, wɔma maa no boroo wɔn ahoɔden so mpo, 4#2 Ko 9.1; Aso 11.29 na wɔkoto srɛɛ yɛn pii sɛ, wɔbɛnya kyɛfa wɔ som a wɔde som ahotefoɔ wɔ adɔeyɛ ho. 5Na ɛnyɛ sɛdeɛ na yɛn ani da soɔ no, na mmom wɔnam Onyankopɔn pɛ so dii kan de wɔn ho maa Awurade, na afei wɔde wɔn ho maa yɛn nso, 6na ama yɛsrɛɛ Tito sɛ, sɛdeɛ ɔfirii aseɛ kane no, ɔnwie adɔeyɛ no saa ara wɔ mo mu. 7#1 Ko 1.5; 16.1-2 Na sɛdeɛ moboro so nnoɔma nyinaa mu no, gyidie ne kasa ne nimdeɛ ne mmɔdemmɔ nyinaa ne ɔdɔ a mode dɔ yɛn mu no, monhwɛ sɛ mobɛboro so adɔeyɛ yi mu nso.
Yesu nhwɛsoɔ
8Menka no ɔhyɛ so, na mmom menam ebinom mmɔdemmɔ so meresɔ mo dɔ mapa no ahwɛ. 9#Mat 8.20 Na monim yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo adom no, sɛ ɔyɛ ɔdefoɔ deɛ, nanso mo nti ɔbɛyɛɛ ohiani, na monam ne hia no so abɛyɛ adefoɔ. 10Na m’adwene a ɛwɔ ho ne sɛ, ɛfata sɛ afei mowie deɛ afe ni, ɛnyɛ ɔyɛ nko ara na mofirii aseɛ yɛeɛ, na mmom monyaa ho pɛ no nso.
Ɔdɔ ne mmoa
11Na afei monwie ne yɛ no nso, na sɛdeɛ mowɔ akoma a ɛpɛ no, moafiri deɛ mowɔ no mu awie ne yɛ no saa ara. 12#Mmb 3.28; Mar 12.43 Na sɛ akoma a ɛpɛ no wɔ hɔ a, ɛsɔ ani, sɛdeɛ onii wɔ adeɛ, na ɛnyɛ sɛdeɛ ɔnnie. 13Na ɛnyɛ sɛ ebinom ho dwo wɔn na mo deɛ mo ho hiahia mo, 14#2 Ko 9.12 na mmom sɛ ɛnyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ nti; na saa berɛ yi mu, mo mmorosoɔ akɔgu wɔn hia mu, na wɔn mmorosoɔ nso abɛgu mo hia mu, na ayɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, 15#Eks 16.18 sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Deɛ ɔboaboaa bebree ano no, annya ammoro so,
na deɛ ɔboaboaa kakraa bi ano no, anhia no hwee.
Tito adwuma foforɔ
16Na aseda nka Onyankopɔn a ɔde mo ho mmɔdemmɔ yi ara bi ahyɛ Tito akoma mu. 17Ɛwɔ mu sɛ yɛn afotuo na ɔtieeɛ deɛ, nanso ne mmɔdemmɔ mmorosoɔ nti na ɔde ɔno ara ne pɛ baa mo nkyɛn. 18Na yɛasoma no ne onua bi a wɔayi no ayɛ wɔ asɛmpa no ka ho wɔ asafo no nyinaa mu no, 19#Gal 2.10 na ɛnyɛ yei nko ara, na ɔno na asafo no ayi no sɛ ɔne yɛn nnante nkura adɔeyɛ a yɛsom ho yi mu, mma Awurade no ara animuonyam, na ɛnkyerɛ yɛn mmɔdemmɔ kɛse no. 20Na yɛda yɛn ho so, na obiara annya yɛn ho asɛm anka wɔ akyɛdeɛ kɛseɛ a yɛsom ho yi ho; 21na yɛdwene deɛ ɛfata, ɛnyɛ Awurade anim nko, na mmom nnipa anim nso.
22Na yɛresoma yɛn nua a yɛanya no asɔ no ahwɛ sɛ ɔyɛ mmɔdemmɔfoɔ wɔ nnoɔma bebree mu no aka wɔn ho, na afei nso awerɛhyɛmu a ɔwɔ no mo mu nti, ɛma ne mmɔdemmɔ no boro so.
23 # 2 Ko 7.13; 12.18; Rom 16.7 Na Tito deɛ, ɔyɛ me yɔnko ne me yɔnko dwumayɛfoɔ ma mo; yɛn nuanom no deɛ, wɔyɛ asafo ahodoɔ no asomafoɔ, Kristo animuonyam. 24#2 Ko 7.14 Enti monyi mo dɔ ne nhoahoa a yɛde hoahoa yɛn ho no nkyerɛ wɔn wɔ asafo ahodoɔ no anim.

pageProps.chapterText:
Nanso, anuanom, yɛrema moahunu Nyankopɔn adom a wɔde adom Makedonia asafo no, ɛfiri sɛ, wɔn ahohiahia sɔhwɛ kɛseɛ mu no, wɔn anigyeɛ buu so maa wɔn wɔ wɔn hia bebrebe mu mpo, wɔyii ayamyɛ kɛseɛ kyerɛe; na medi wɔn ho adanseɛ sɛ, wɔde wɔn ara wɔn pɛ maa sɛdeɛ wɔbɛtumi, wɔma maa no boroo wɔn ahoɔden so mpo, na wɔkoto srɛɛ yɛn pii sɛ, wɔbɛnya kyɛfa wɔ som a wɔde som ahotefoɔ wɔ adɔeyɛ ho. Na ɛnyɛ sɛdeɛ na yɛn ani da soɔ no, na mmom wɔnam Onyankopɔn pɛ so dii kan de wɔn ho maa Awurade, na afei wɔde wɔn ho maa yɛn nso, na ama yɛsrɛɛ Tito sɛ, sɛdeɛ ɔfirii aseɛ kane no, ɔnwie adɔeyɛ no saa ara wɔ mo mu. Na sɛdeɛ moboro so nnoɔma nyinaa mu no, gyidie ne kasa ne nimdeɛ ne mmɔdemmɔ nyinaa ne ɔdɔ a mode dɔ yɛn mu no, monhwɛ sɛ mobɛboro so adɔeyɛ yi mu nso.

Menka no ɔhyɛ so, na mmom menam ebinom mmɔdemmɔ so meresɔ mo dɔ mapa no ahwɛ. Na monim yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo adom no, sɛ ɔyɛ ɔdefoɔ deɛ, nanso mo nti ɔbɛyɛɛ ohiani, na monam ne hia no so abɛyɛ adefoɔ. Na m’adwene a ɛwɔ ho ne sɛ, ɛfata sɛ afei mowie deɛ afe ni, ɛnyɛ ɔyɛ nko ara na mofirii aseɛ yɛeɛ, na mmom monyaa ho pɛ no nso.

Na afei monwie ne yɛ no nso, na sɛdeɛ mowɔ akoma a ɛpɛ no, moafiri deɛ mowɔ no mu awie ne yɛ no saa ara. Na sɛ akoma a ɛpɛ no wɔ hɔ a, ɛsɔ ani, sɛdeɛ onii wɔ adeɛ, na ɛnyɛ sɛdeɛ ɔnnie. Na ɛnyɛ sɛ ebinom ho dwo wɔn na mo deɛ mo ho hiahia mo, na mmom sɛ ɛnyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ nti; na saa berɛ yi mu, mo mmorosoɔ akɔgu wɔn hia mu, na wɔn mmorosoɔ nso abɛgu mo hia mu, na ayɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Deɛ ɔboaboaa bebree ano no, annya ammoro so,
na deɛ ɔboaboaa kakraa bi ano no, anhia no hwee.

Na aseda nka Onyankopɔn a ɔde mo ho mmɔdemmɔ yi ara bi ahyɛ Tito akoma mu. Ɛwɔ mu sɛ yɛn afotuo na ɔtieeɛ deɛ, nanso ne mmɔdemmɔ mmorosoɔ nti na ɔde ɔno ara ne pɛ baa mo nkyɛn. Na yɛasoma no ne onua bi a wɔayi no ayɛ wɔ asɛmpa no ka ho wɔ asafo no nyinaa mu no, na ɛnyɛ yei nko ara, na ɔno na asafo no ayi no sɛ ɔne yɛn nnante nkura adɔeyɛ a yɛsom ho yi mu, mma Awurade no ara animuonyam, na ɛnkyerɛ yɛn mmɔdemmɔ kɛse no. Na yɛda yɛn ho so, na obiara annya yɛn ho asɛm anka wɔ akyɛdeɛ kɛseɛ a yɛsom ho yi ho; na yɛdwene deɛ ɛfata, ɛnyɛ Awurade anim nko, na mmom nnipa anim nso.
Na yɛresoma yɛn nua a yɛanya no asɔ no ahwɛ sɛ ɔyɛ mmɔdemmɔfoɔ wɔ nnoɔma bebree mu no aka wɔn ho, na afei nso awerɛhyɛmu a ɔwɔ no mo mu nti, ɛma ne mmɔdemmɔ no boro so.
Na Tito deɛ, ɔyɛ me yɔnko ne me yɔnko dwumayɛfoɔ ma mo; yɛn nuanom no deɛ, wɔyɛ asafo ahodoɔ no asomafoɔ, Kristo animuonyam. Enti monyi mo dɔ ne nhoahoa a yɛde hoahoa yɛn ho no nkyerɛ wɔn wɔ asafo ahodoɔ no anim.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
